namespace = cwp_decolonization

# Cold War Project: the Winds of Change (je_cwp_winds_of_change)
# Generated by gen_events.py in the decolonization thread's scratchpad; edit freely.

cwp_decolonization.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	duration = 3

	title = cwp_decolonization.1.t
	desc = cwp_decolonization.1.d
	flavor = cwp_decolonization.1.f

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_city_center"
	}
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	trigger = {
		exists = scope:cwp_new_state
	}

	immediate = {
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					c:USA ?= this
					c:RUS ?= this
				}
				has_variable = cwp_champions_self_determination
			}
			change_relations = {
				country = root
				value = 20
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_modifier = cwp_new_nation } }
			add_modifier = {
				name = cwp_new_nation
				years = 10
				is_decaying = yes
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = cwp_decolonization.1.a
		default_option = yes
		c:USA ?= { change_relations = { country = root value = 10 } }
		c:RUS ?= { change_relations = { country = root value = 10 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = cwp_decolonization.1.b
		trigger = {
			exists = c:USA
		}
		c:USA ?= { change_relations = { country = root value = 30 } }
		c:RUS ?= { change_relations = { country = root value = -10 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 20
			modifier = {
				trigger = { c:USA ?= { has_variable = cwp_champions_self_determination } }
				add = 20
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = { cwp_has_imperialist_leaning_government = yes }
				add = 20
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = cwp_decolonization.1.c
		trigger = {
			exists = c:RUS
		}
		c:RUS ?= { change_relations = { country = root value = 30 } }
		c:USA ?= { change_relations = { country = root value = -10 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = {
				trigger = { c:RUS ?= { has_variable = cwp_champions_self_determination } }
				add = 10
			}
			modifier = {
				trigger = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { is_in_government = yes } }
				add = 20
			}
		}
	}
}

cwp_decolonization.2 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	duration = 3

	title = cwp_decolonization.2.t
	desc = cwp_decolonization.2.d
	flavor = cwp_decolonization.2.f

	event_image = {
		video = "unspecific_signed_contract"
	}
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	trigger = {
		exists = scope:cwp_new_state
	}

	option = {
		name = cwp_decolonization.2.a
		default_option = yes
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:cwp_new_state
			value = 20
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 70
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = cwp_decolonization.2.b
		change_relations = {
			country = scope:cwp_new_state
			value = -30
		}
		add_modifier = {
			name = cwp_end_of_empire
			years = 5
			is_decaying = yes
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				trigger = { cwp_has_imperialist_leaning_government = yes }
				add = 30
			}
		}
	}
}

cwp_decolonization.3 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	duration = 3

	title = cwp_decolonization.3.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_decolonization.3.d_4
				trigger = { global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 4 }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_decolonization.3.d_3
				trigger = { global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 3 }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_decolonization.3.d_2
				trigger = { global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 2 }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_decolonization.3.d_1
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_decolonization.3.f_4
				trigger = { global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 4 }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_decolonization.3.f_3
				trigger = { global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 3 }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_decolonization.3.f_2
				trigger = { global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 2 }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_decolonization.3.f_1
			}
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_public_protest"
	}
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	option = {
		name = cwp_decolonization.3.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}
